'''''Miss Theelin''''' was a beauty pageant held during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and was organized for [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]].
